# Cade's Liquidation

> New and scratch-and-dent appliances at liquidation prices in Bloomington-Normal, Illinois.

Cade's Liquidation is a scratch-and-dent appliance reseller in Normal, IL, run by Cade McClellan.
It sells brand-new appliances with cosmetic damage (dents, scratches from shipping/handling)
at roughly 30% or more below retail. Every unit is unboxed, plugged in, and tested before it is
listed. One of each item is in stock ("when it's gone, it's gone").

- Website: [cadesliquidation.com](https://cadesliquidation.com/)
- Phone: (309) 434-4800 (call or text)
- Address: 1206 S Adelaide St Suite 7, Normal, IL — by appointment only
- Service area: Bloomington-Normal, IL and surrounding communities
- Hours: by appointment — call or text to schedule
- Delivery: $50 flat to the door in Bloomington-Normal; contact for quotes outside the area
- Installation services available for an additional charge
- Guarantee: 14-day money-back on every appliance
- Rating: 4.9/5 from 273+ Facebook Marketplace ratings

## Inventory

Appliances: washers, dryers, refrigerators (French door, side-by-side, top-freezer),
ranges (gas and electric), freezers (chest and upright), dishwashers, wall ovens.
Bundle discounts: 3% off 2 items, 8% off 3 items, 15% off 4+ items.

- [Full catalog](https://cadesliquidation.com/)
- [Bundle builder](https://cadesliquidation.com/bundle/)
